card.name: Verb before fetal harm statements
card.fires_on: The word right after a drug name or "can" in an Embryo-Fetal Toxicity warning, such as "can cause" or "can result in", just before fetal harm. Also "development of" before drug-resistant bacteria.

modes.label: Embryo-fetal warning
modes.description: Verb or drug name leading into the statement that the drug can cause fetal harm.
modes.example: Exposure to ENHERTU during pregnancy can<< cause>> embryo-fetal harm.

modes.label: Drug-resistant bacteria
modes.description: The word "of" in the antibacterial stewardship warning about resistance.
modes.example: increases the risk of the development<< of>> drug-resistant bacteria.
